Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL3775 (M-phase inducer phosphatase 1). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Require exact standard relation '=' and non-null pChEMBL values. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to include canonical SMILES. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to the first 1000 rows.
